content.short: ZetaChain is a universal L1 blockchain that enables omnichain smart contracts across any network including Bitcoin.
content.description: ZetaChain is a pioneering decentralized Layer 1 blockchain specifically engineered for universal interoperability between disparate networks. By utilizing a unique Threshold Signature Scheme (TSS) and "Omnichain Smart Contracts," the platform allows developers to build applications that can natively manage assets and data across multiple chains—including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Cosmos—without the need for wrapped tokens or centralized bridges. Acting as a foundational communication and settlement layer for the cross-chain web, ZetaChain simplifies the multi-chain experience.
content.meta: ZetaChain provides universal Layer 1 infrastructure for omnichain smart contracts. Discover ZetaChain and other Blockchains on Lancers Explorer.
